description: Utility functions for parsing SEC Form 13F-HR filings, including fetching filings, parsing headers, and processing filing data into structured formats.

methods.name: date_to_quarter_end
methods.description: Converts a date string to the end date of the corresponding calendar quarter.

methods.name: get_13f_candidates
methods.description: Fetches 13F-HR filings for a given symbol or CIK, filtering out filings before June 30, 2013.

methods.name: complete_submission_callback
methods.description: Processes the response object to retrieve the text content if the request was successful.

methods.name: get_complete_submission
methods.description: Retrieves the complete submission TXT file from SEC API given a URL.

methods.name: parse_header
methods.description: Parses the header section of a complete submission TXT file to extract metadata.

methods.name: get_submission_type
methods.description: Extracts the submission type from the parsed header.

methods.name: get_period_ending
methods.description: Extracts the report period date from the parsed header.

methods.name: parse_13f_hr
methods.description: Parses a 13F-HR filing (from URL or string) into a structured DataFrame of holdings.
